title: GE4u Daily Practice: Dental English
objective: Recognize common terms for oral conditions and describe them accurately in basic dental English.

vocabulary.definition: An unpleasant odour of the breath.
vocabulary.example: The patient asked about persistent halitosis.

vocabulary.definition: Pain in or around a tooth.
vocabulary.example: The patient reported a severe toothache at night.

vocabulary.definition: An assessment of the oral cavity, teeth, gingiva and related structures.
vocabulary.example: An oral examination is part of the initial dental assessment.

quiz.question: Which structure is the hard outer covering of the crown of a tooth?
quiz.explanation: Enamel covers the crown and protects the underlying tooth tissues.
